body.text:
The rule that flags a line billed meaningfully above its contracted rate is implemented in the function `rule_rate_variance` in the file `src/invoiceguard/spine/rules_engine.py`. The rule triggers when the unit rate exceeds the active contract rate by more than a configurable percentage, `rate_variance_pct`. The relevant code is:

```python
def rule_rate_variance(
    session: Session,
    clock: Clock,
    invoice: Invoice,
    line: InvoiceLine,
    contracts: list[Contract],
    config,
) -> None:
    """A line billed meaningfully above its contracted rate.

    Trips when the unit rate exceeds the active contract rate by more
    than ``rate_variance_pct`` (config-tunable). The recovery amount is
    the full delta back to contract, not just the part beyond the
    threshold.
    """
    rate_variance_pct = config.rate_variance_pct
    contract = _active_contract(contracts, line.item_code, invoice.received_at)
    if contract is None:
        return
    if line.unit_rate > contract.contract_rate * (1.0 + rate_variance_pct):
        persist_finding(
            session,
            clock,
            invoice_id=invoice.id,
            rule_name="rate_variance",
            category=_line_class(line),
            line_number=line.line_number,
            description=(
                f"Rate {line.unit_rate} exceeds contract rate "
                f"{contract.contract_rate} by more than "
                f"{rate_variance_pct:.0%}"
            ),
            amount=(line.unit_rate - contract.contract_rate) * line.quantity,
        )
```

This function is located between lines 116 and 149 in the file.

def rule_rate_variance(
    session: Session,
    clock: Clock,
    invoice: Invoice,
    line: InvoiceLine,
    contracts: list[Contract],
    config,
) -> None:
    """A line billed meaningfully above its contracted rate.

    Trips when the unit rate exceeds the active contract rate by more
    than ``rate_variance_pct`` (config-tunable). The recovery amount is
    the full delta back to contract, not just the part beyond the
    threshold.
    """
    rate_variance_pct = config.rate_variance_pct
    contract = _active_contract(contracts, line.item_code, invoice.received_at)
    if contract is None:
        return
    if line.unit_rate > contract.contract_rate * (1.0 + rate_variance_pct):
        persist_finding(
            session,
            clock,
            invoice_id=invoice.id,
            rule_name="rate_variance",
            category=_line_class(line),
            line_number=line.line_number,
            description=(
                f"Rate {line.unit_rate} exceeds contract rate "
                f"{contract.contract_rate} by more than "
                f"{rate_variance_pct:.0%}"
            ),
            amount=(line.unit_rate - contract.contract_rate) * line.quantity,
        )

    session: Session,
    clock: Clock,
    invoice: Invoice,
    line: InvoiceLine,
    contracts: list[Contract],
    config,
) -> None:
    """A line billed meaningfully above its contracted rate.

    Trips when the unit rate exceeds the active contract rate by more
    than ``rate_variance_pct`` (config-tunable). The recovery amount is
    the full delta back to contract, not just the part beyond the
    threshold.
    """
    rate_variance_pct = config.rate_variance_pct
    contract = _active_contract(contracts, line.item_code, invoice.received_at)
    if contract is None:

def rule_rate_variance(
    session: Session,
    clock: Clock,
    invoice: Invoice,
    line: InvoiceLine,
    contracts: list[Contract],
    config,
) -> None:
    """A line billed meaningfully above its contracted rate.

    Trips when the unit rate exceeds the active contract rate by more
    than ``rate_variance_pct`` (config-tunable). The recovery amount is
    the full delta back to contract, not just the part beyond the
    threshold.
    """
    rate_variance_pct = config.rate_variance_pct
    contract = _active_contract(contracts, line.item_code, invoice.received_at)
    if contract is None:
        return
    if line.unit_rate > contract.contract_rate * (1.0 + rate_variance_pct):
        persist_finding(
            session,
            clock,
            invoice_id=invoice.id,
            rule_name="rate_variance",
            category=_line_class(line),
            line_number=line.line_number,
            description=(
                f"Rate {line.unit_rate} exceeds contract rate "
                f"{contract.contract_rate} by more than "
                f"{rate_variance_pct:.0%}"
            ),
            amount=(line.unit_rate - contract.contract_rate) * line.quantity,
        )

def rule_rate_variance(
    session: Session,
    clock: Clock,
    invoice: Invoice,
    line: InvoiceLine,
    contracts: list[Contract],
    config,
) -> None:
    """A line billed meaningfully above its contracted rate.

    Trips when the unit rate exceeds the active contract rate by more
    than ``rate_variance_pct`` (config-tunable). The recovery amount is
    the full delta back to contract, not just the part beyond the
    threshold.
    """
    rate_variance_pct = config.rate_variance_pct
    contract = _active_contract(contracts, line.item_code, invoice.received_at)
    if contract is None:
        return
    if line.unit_rate > contract.contract_rate * (1.0 + rate_variance_pct):
        persist_finding(
            session,
            clock,
            invoice_id=invoice.id,
            rule_name="rate_variance",
            category=_line_class(line),
            line_number=line.line_number,
            description=(
                f"Rate {line.unit_rate} exceeds contract rate "
                f"{contract.contract_rate} by more than "
                f"{rate_variance_pct:.0%}"
            ),
            amount=(line.unit_rate - contract.contract_rate) * line.quantity,
        )

```python
def rule_rate_variance(
    session: Session,
    clock: Clock,
    invoice: Invoice,
    line: InvoiceLine,
    contracts: list[Contract],
    config,
) -> None:
    """A line billed meaningfully above its contracted rate.

    Trips when the unit rate exceeds the active contract rate by more
    than ``rate_variance_pct`` (config-tunable). The recovery amount is
    the full delta back to contract, not just the part beyond the
    threshold.
    """
    rate_variance_pct = config.rate_variance_pct
    contract = _active_contract(contracts, line.item_code, invoice.received_at)
    if contract is None:
        return
    if line.unit_rate > contract.contract_rate * (1.0 + rate_variance_pct):
        persist_finding(
            session,
            clock,
            invoice_id=invoice.id,
            rule_name="rate_variance",
            category=_line_class(line),
            line_number=line.line_number,
            description=(
                f"Rate {line.unit_rate} exceeds contract rate "
                f"{contract.contract_rate} by more than "
                f"{rate_variance_pct:.0%}"
            ),
            amount=(line.unit_rate - contract.contract_rate) * line.quantity,
        )
```

This function checks if a line in an invoice is billed above its contracted rate by more than a configurable percentage (`rate_variance_pct`). If so, it records a finding with the details of the discrepancy.
